subject: Mutual Action Plan Kickoff — Private deployment (VPC & on-prem)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@octagoncloud.com>, Aaron Park <aaron.park@octagoncloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan Kickoff — Private deployment (VPC & on-prem)

Jamie / Aaron — thanks for the time last week. Per our call, I wanted to start a concise MAP thread to align owners, timeline, and the evaluation steps for the private deployment (VPC + optional on-prem nodes). Goal: agree on owner roster and a 6‑week evaluation/PO cadence so engineering can size infra and we can schedule a staging run.

High level asks (please reply with names/contacts):
- Networking / VPN owner (responsible for transit, peering, IPSec/BGP handover)
- Cloud IAM + KMS custodian (who will own key rotation / access lists)
- On‑prem topology owner (if you plan a co‑located node: rack contact / NOC)
- Security/compliance liaison (SOC2 evidence, egress policies, DLP)

Proposed milestones:
- Week 0: MAP kickoff + owner roster (this thread)
- Week 1–2: Security questionnaire & network diagram exchange
- Week 3: Staging connectivity test (VPN tunnel, KV persistence test)
- Week 4–5: Evaluation load window (throughput/latency)
- Week 6: Go/no‑go and procurement (PO or Dedicated commit)

Attached: redwood_map_template_v1.xlsx — fill in owners + dates and upload to the HubSpot link below.

Can you confirm names for the four roles above and your preferred dates/times for a 45‑minute technical session (we recommend 12/3–12/5 PST)?

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-2901

Attachments: redwood_map_template_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42 KB)

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan Kickoff — Private deployment (VPC & on-prem)

Thanks Diego — appreciate the clear plan. Quick responses below and assigning leads on our side: 
- Networking / VPN owner: Aaron Park (aaron.park@octagoncloud.com) — will include our VPN engineer J. Lee (jlee@octagoncloud.com) for the tunnel/route handoff.
- Cloud IAM + KMS custodian: Priya Shah (priya.shah@octagoncloud.com) — she'll handle KMS policies and key access; she sits in our security team.
- On‑prem topology owner: Mark Rivers <mark.rivers@octagonops.com> — third‑party colo partner (will loop him in once we have the topology doc).
- Security/compliance liaison: security@octagoncloud.com (primary) — SOC2 pack request is OK, we'll send the initial evidence by 12/5.

We have an initial VPC diagram attached (octagon_vpc_diagram_v1.pdf). We can do the technical session on 12/04 at 10:00 AM PST — that works for Aaron, J. Lee and Priya.

I'll ask Priya to start filling the MAP template and circulate an internal copy once it's complete.

-Jamie
VP, Cloud Platform — Octagon Cloud
jamie.liu@octagoncloud.com

Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 08:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan Kickoff — Private deployment (VPC & on-prem)

Thanks Jamie — tagging a couple of clarifying items from the infra side so we scope the staging run correctly: 
1) Throughput target for the evaluation window — what's the expected peak concurrent requests/requests per second and average sequence length? This drives GPU and KV sizing.
2) For on‑prem KV persistence: will you host Redis/rocksdb in your colo (Mark Rivers) or do you want Redwood to provision a local VM for cache persistency?
3) KMS: is Priya OK with us using an external KMS (we support AWS KMS / GCP KMS / customer HSM via PKCS#11) or do you require on‑prem HSM?

I've attached our private-deploy-ops-checklist.docx to help structure the session. For the tech session on 12/04, please include network diagrams with CIDR ranges and the proposed BGP/peer IPs if you have them.

-Vivek
Sr. Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

Attachments: private-deploy-ops-checklist.docx (docx, 78 KB)
From: Aaron Park <aaron.park@octagoncloud.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: J. Lee <jlee@octagoncloud.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@octagoncloud.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 10:15:00 -06:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan Kickoff — Private deployment (VPC & on-prem)

Vivek — good questions, short answers below: 
- Throughput: initial eval target = 400 qps sustained, 1k qps short bursts; average sequence length ~120 tokens. Will confirm P95 latency goal during the call.
- KV persistence: Mark Rivers (our colo partner) will host persistent stores in the colo for on‑prem nodes. We'll provide access and a maintenance window for bootstrapping.
- KMS: Priya confirmed they prefer customer‑managed KMS in AWS for now (not an HSM). We'll provide the ARN and KMS policy pre‑call.

We'll join 12/04 10:00 AM PST — J. Lee will bring the VPN configs (we'll send BGP peer IPs and proposed route filters ahead of the meeting).

-Aaron
Director, Infrastructure — Octagon Cloud
aaron.park@octagoncloud.com
